title: COLOR BLOCK JAM 3D // SHREDDER ESCAPE
validationNote: Rank #1 revenue breakout in hybrid-casual puzzles ($25M-$42M/quarter benchmark). Satisfying 3D block sliding into color-matched perimeter shredder gates with voxel particle bursts; zero external 3D models required.
coreLoop: Slide vibrant beveled 3D polyomino blocks across a floating sunlit grid toward matching color-coded perimeter shredder gates. When a block touches its matching gate, it is pulled through and shredded into a burst of colorful cubes, clearing space for remaining blocks.
solvableMathSpec: Reverse-shuffle solver: start from an empty board, pull blocks inward from perimeter gates in valid reverse steps so every generated puzzle is 100% solvable within target par moves.
cameraErgonomics: Elevated isometric-orbital 3D camera with unobstructed floating board (no ground plane blocking bottom/side views). Dynamically scales FOV to fit 9:16 portrait and 16:9 landscape viewports.

inLevelBoosters: Hammer Smash (Instantly shatters any chosen 3D block into particles via Rewarded Ad or 100 Coins)
Freeze Timer / +20s (Adds 20 seconds or +5 moves via Rewarded Ad)
Color Vacuum (Automatically shreds all blocks of a single color via Rewarded Ad)
revenueHooks.nearMissRevive: When timer/moves hit 0 with 1–2 blocks left on board, trigger 'Almost Shredded! Watch Ad for +15s & Instant Hammer'.
revenueHooks.victoryMultiplier: Oscillating 1.5x / 2x / 3x / 5x needle gauge on Level Complete screen for multiplied Coin payouts.

assetSpec.proceduralPrefabs: Beveled ExtrudeGeometry L/T/I/Square blocks with glossy toy-plastic specular highlights, rotating cylindrical shredder rollers on matching perimeter gates, and pooled voxel shred particles.

title: SCREW JAM 3D // HYPER UNBOLT
validationNote: Top-grossing 3D pin/screw puzzle subgenre leader. Dock buffer-slot pressure creates industry-highest rewarded ad conversion for Extra Hole and Revive hooks.
coreLoop: Orbit a floating multi-layered 3D sculpture made of translucent colored plates held together by metallic screws. Tap exposed screws to unscrew and fly them into matching 3-slot color toolboxes; when all pins holding a plate are removed, the plate drops away in physics.
solvableMathSpec: Layered reverse-assembly generator guarantees active toolboxes always match accessible outer-layer screws so the 5-hole buffer dock never forces an unavoidable deadlock.
cameraErgonomics: Full 360° spherical orbit around the suspended 3D assembly; strictly zero ground pedestal so underside screws are 100% visible and tappable.

inLevelBoosters: Extra Buffer Hole (Unlocks a 6th/7th temporary dock hole via Rewarded Ad)
Magnet Unbolt (Extracts 3 screws matching the active toolbox via Rewarded Ad)
Plate Shatter (Breaks one obstructing plate immediately via Rewarded Ad)
revenueHooks.nearMissRevive: When all 5 buffer holes fill up, show 'Buffer Full! Watch Ad to Clear Buffer + Unlock Extra Toolbox'.
revenueHooks.victoryMultiplier: Oscillating 1.5x / 2x / 3x / 5x needle bar on Level Complete screen.

assetSpec.proceduralPrefabs: LatheGeometry threaded bolts with cross-head slots, beveled translucent ExtrudeGeometry plates, and 3D hinged toolboxes.

solvableMathSpec: Smart tray generator biases spawned stack colors toward existing top colors on the board when board occupancy exceeds 65%, ensuring smooth cascade chains.
cameraErgonomics: Clean top-down / tilted orbital view over a floating honeycomb island with zero bottom/side visual clutter. Seamless one-thumb drag in 9:16 portrait.

inLevelBoosters: Stack Hammer (Clears any single hex cell stack via Rewarded Ad or Coins)
Swap Hand (Refreshes the 3 draggable hex stacks in the tray via Rewarded Ad)
Move Stack (Relocates an existing stack on the board via Rewarded Ad)
revenueHooks.nearMissRevive: When no empty hex cells remain on the honeycomb, offer 'No Space Left! Watch Ad to Clear 3 Random Stacks'.
revenueHooks.victoryMultiplier: Oscillating 1.5x / 2x / 3x / 5x coin multiplier bar at level goal completion.

assetSpec.proceduralPrefabs: Beveled 6-sided Cylinder/Extrude hex tiles with embossed top icons and spring-physics arc flip animations.
